spark.name: Hawk
spark.text: Passive: 3 damage to a random enemy at the end of your turn. Awaken: 8 damage to a random enemy.

splinter.name: Splinter
splinter.text: Planted with a charge of 4. Passive: damage equal to its charge to ALL enemies at the end of your turn, then its charge falls by 1. Awaken: twice its charge to ALL enemies.

ward.name: Bear
ward.text: Passive: 2 Barrier at the end of your turn. Awaken: 5 Barrier.

hollow.name: Elder
hollow.text: Planted with a charge of 6; charges by 6 more at the end of each of your turns (Spirit adds to that). Awaken: damage equal to its charge to the enemy with the least HP.

prism.name: Owl
prism.text: Passive: gain 1 Mana at the start of your turn. Awaken: gain 2 Mana.

ward-stone.name: Ward Stone
ward-stone.text: Start each fight Shielded: ignore the first hit.

ember-lamp.name: Ember Lamp
ember-lamp.text: Gain 2 Barrier at the start of each of your turns.

rift-satchel.name: Rift Satchel
rift-satchel.text: Draw 2 more cards on the first turn of each fight.

coin-purse.name: Shard Purse
coin-purse.text: Gain 10 extra shards after every fight.

vigor-wick.name: Vigor Wick
vigor-wick.text: Heal 2 HP at the start of each of your turns.

hex-lantern.name: Hex Lantern
hex-lantern.text: Every enemy starts each fight Faltering for 2 turns.

hunters-lens.name: Hunter's Lens
hunters-lens.text: Every enemy starts each fight Exposed for 2 turns.

scholars-tome.name: Scholar's Tome
scholars-tome.text: Draw 1 extra card at the start of each of your turns.

aegis-of-ages.name: Aegis of Ages
aegis-of-ages.text: Start each fight Shielded 3 times: ignore the first three hits.

gilded-crown.name: The Gilded Crown
gilded-crown.text: Gain 25 max HP, and heal 10 HP after every fight.

ember-heart.name: Ember Heart
ember-heart.text: +1 Mana every turn. Draw one card fewer every turn.

gluttons-heart.name: Glutton's Heart
gluttons-heart.text: Draw one card more every turn. 15 less Max HP.

blood-heart.name: Blood Heart
blood-heart.text: +1 Mana every turn. Lose 3 HP at the start of each of your turns.

thorned-heart.name: Thorned Heart
thorned-heart.text: Start each fight with 6 Thorns and 2 Might, and Exposed for 2 turns.

warded-heart.name: Warded Heart
warded-heart.text: Start each fight with 16 Barrier and Shielded. At the start of each of your turns, become Brittle (the Barrier you gain is 25% smaller).

frost-phial.name: Frost Phial
frost-phial.text: Apply 3 Exposed and 2 Faltering to ALL enemies.

trait.name: Oathkeeper
trait.text: Start every fight with 6 Barrier and 6 Plating: your Barrier survives each turn up to your Plating, which shrinks by 1 a turn.

trait.name: Tinkerer
trait.text: At the start of your turn, you heal 1 and your companions gain 1 max HP. Salvage: a companion you build by scrapping others to make room takes their Might and Primed, and half their HP as extra max HP.

trait.name: Pack Instinct
trait.text: Your companions share half your Might (rounded down), and a new companion arrives with it. Heal 2 HP after every fight you win.

trait.name: Lying in Wait
trait.text: Start every fight with 6 Barrier and 1 extra card in hand. The first time each turn you have played all four suits (♠ ♥ ♦ ♣), a Full Trick: deal 3 damage to a random enemy, 2 more for every Full Trick before it this fight, and draw 1 card.

trait.name: Hidden Blades
trait.text: At the start of your turn, add a Dagger to your hand.

trait.name: Totem-bound
trait.text: Start every fight with three different totems: Hawk, Bear and Splinter.

trait.name: Inner Fire
trait.text: Whenever you enter a stance, gain 1 Fervor. The first time each turn you leave Serene, gain 2 Mana. Whenever you leave Fury, gain 2 Primed.

trait.name: Kindled
trait.text: At the start of your turn, gain 1 Arcana and Sharpen your Obsidian Blade by 1.

trait.name: Clutch Genes
trait.text: You deal 1% more attack damage for every HP you are missing.

trait.name: Grave Chill
trait.text: At the start of your turn, Raise 2. Whenever one of your allies dies, curse a random enemy with 2 Fate; whenever a card is consumed, with 3.
